requirements.text: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.
Each order line quantity is an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive; quantities 0 and 101 are rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.title: Create an order as sales_manager with the minimum valid quantity
preconditions: A user with the sales_manager role exists and can authenticate.
A valid order payload can be prepared with one order line.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders payload with one order line whose quantity is integer 1.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is sent with the sales_manager user's credentials.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with the prepared payload containing quantity 1.
steps.expected_result: The response status is HTTP 201 and the response code is CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The valid sales_manager order creation request is accepted with HTTP 201 and code CREATED.

test_cases.title: Create an order with the maximum valid line quantity
preconditions: A user with the sales_manager role exists and can authenticate.
A valid order payload can be prepared with one order line.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders payload with one order line whose quantity is integer 100.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is sent with the sales_manager user's credentials.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with the prepared payload containing quantity 100.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted because quantity 100 is within the inclusive allowed range.

test_cases.expected_outcome: An order line with quantity 100 is accepted as a valid boundary value.

test_cases.title: Reject an order line quantity of zero
preconditions: A user with the sales_manager role exists and can authenticate.
A valid order payload can be prepared with one order line except for the quantity value.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders payload with one order line whose quantity is integer 0.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is sent with the sales_manager user's credentials.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with the prepared payload containing quantity 0.
steps.expected_result: The response status is HTTP 422 and the response error code is QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 0 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Reject an order line quantity above the maximum
preconditions: A user with the sales_manager role exists and can authenticate.
A valid order payload can be prepared with one order line except for the quantity value.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders payload with one order line whose quantity is integer 101.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is sent with the sales_manager user's credentials.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with the prepared payload containing quantity 101.
steps.expected_result: The response status is HTTP 422 and the response error code is QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 101 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Deny order creation for the viewer role
preconditions: A user with the viewer role exists and can authenticate.
A valid order payload can be prepared with one order line.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders payload with one order line whose quantity is integer 1.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is sent with the viewer user's credentials.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with the prepared valid payload.
steps.expected_result: The response status is HTTP 403 and the response code is FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The viewer role cannot create an order and receives HTTP 403 with code FORBIDDEN.
